```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
dat <- read.csv("real_estate_dataset.csv")
options(scipen = 999)
# Drops Id column

dat[11] <- NULL
dat[10] <- NULL

set.seed(36473)                 # same seed as Project 1
n   <- nrow(dat)
idx <- sample(n, round(0.8 * n))
train <- dat[sort(idx), ]           # 80%: use for ALL of Project 2
test  <- dat[-idx, ]                # 20%: LOCKED until the Final Project


# Full dataset
anyNA(dat)

colnames(train)[2] <- "Square_Meters"
head(train)

library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
```


```{r}
reqs <- c("Observations after removing missing values (at least 100)",
          "Response Variable is continuous (name and units)",
          "Number of candidate predictors (4–8), including at least one categorical (name and levels)",
          "Cross-sectional: one row per unit, not a time series",
          "Not an R or R-package dataset, a widely used teaching dataset, a Kutner dataset, or a dataset a member has analyzed in another course",
          "Proposal status: approved / approved with revisions (revisions made: …) / not yet approved")
ans <- c(n, "Price (of home) in Dollars", "Square Feet, Number of Bedrooms, Number of Bathrooms, Number of Floors, Year Built, Garage Size (m^2), Pool Status: Yes or No, Garden Status: Yes or No", "True", "Yes", "Approved")
```

# II

```{r}
vars <- train[, c("Square_Meters", "Num_Bedrooms", "Num_Bathrooms",
                  "Num_Floors", "Year_Built", "Garage_Size")]
eda <- data.frame(
  n = sapply(vars, length),
  mean = sapply(vars, mean),
  SD = sapply(vars, sd),
  Min = sapply(vars, min),
  Max = sapply(vars, max)
)

cat_vars <- train[, c("Has_Garden", "Has_Pool")]
cat_count <- data.frame(
  yes = colSums(cat_vars == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
  no = colSums(cat_vars == 0, na.rm = FALSE)
)

kable(eda, digits = 2, caption = "Summary Statistics, 400 Houses", align = "rrrrr")
kable(cat_count, caption = "Count of Each Level", align = "rr")
```



# III

```{r}
options(scipen = 0)
full.model <- lm(Price ~ Square_Meters + Num_Bedrooms + Num_Bathrooms + Num_Floors + Year_Built + Garage_Size + Has_Garden + Has_Pool, data = train)

betas_summary <- data.frame(
  b_k = summary(full.model)$coefficients[, "Estimate"],
  Sb_k = summary(full.model)$coefficients[, "Std. Error"],
  t = summary(full.model)$coefficients[, "t value"],
  Pvalue = format(summary(full.model)$coefficients[, "Pr(>|t|)"], scientific = TRUE),
  VIF = c(NA, car::vif(full.model))
)
kable(betas_summary, digits = 2, caption = "Summary of Betas Statistics", align = "rrcrr")
```

# IV

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("leaps", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("leaps", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}

library(leaps)
```

## a.

```{r}
best.subsets <- leaps::regsubsets(
  Price ~ Square_Meters + Num_Bedrooms + Num_Bathrooms +
    Num_Floors + Year_Built + Garage_Size +
    Has_Garden + Has_Pool,
  data = train,
  nvmax = 8
)
best.summary <- summary(best.subsets)

best.adjr2 <- which.max(best.summary$adjr2)
best.cp <- which.min(best.summary$cp)
best.bic <- which.min(best.summary$bic)

best.adjr2
best.cp
best.bic

which.models <- best.summary$which

models <- lapply(1:8, function(i) {

  predictors <- colnames(which.models)[
    which.models[i, ] &
      colnames(which.models) != "(Intercept)"
  ]

  model.formula <- as.formula(
    paste("Price ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))
  )

  lm(model.formula, data = train)
})

AICp <- sapply(models, function(fit) {
  extractAIC(fit)[2]
})

n <- nrow(train)

SBCp <- sapply(models, function(fit) {
  extractAIC(fit, k = log(n))[2]
})

PRESSp <- sapply(models, function(fit) {
  sum((resid(fit) / (1 - hatvalues(fit)))^2)
})

selection.table <- data.frame(
  Number_of_Predictors = 1:8,
  Adjusted_R2 = best.summary$adjr2,
  Cp = best.summary$cp,
  AICp = AICp,
  SBCp = SBCp,
  PRESSp = PRESSp
)

kable(
  selection.table,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Best Subsets Model Selection Criteria",
  align = "c",
  booktabs = TRUE
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
    full_width = TRUE,
    position = "center",
    font_size = 12
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "3cm") %>%
  column_spec(2:6, width = "2.5cm")

best.aic <- which.min(AICp)
best.sbc <- which.min(SBCp)
best.press <- which.min(PRESSp)

cat("Best Adjusted R-squared:", best.adjr2)
cat("\nBest Cp:", best.cp)
cat("\nBest AICp:", best.aic)
cat("\nBest SBCp:", best.sbc)
cat("\nBest PRESSp:", best.press)



```

## c)
```{r}
press.model <- models[[best.press]]

candidate.models <- list(
  Full = full.model,
  Stepwise = step.model,
  Best_PRESS = press.model
)

model.comparison <- data.frame(
  Model = names(candidate.models),

  Adjusted_R2 = sapply(candidate.models, function(fit) {
    summary(fit)$adj.r.squared
  }),

  AICp = sapply(candidate.models, function(fit) {
    extractAIC(fit)[2]
  }),

  SBCp = sapply(candidate.models, function(fit) {
    extractAIC(fit, k = log(n))[2]
  }),

  PRESSp = sapply(candidate.models, function(fit) {
    sum((resid(fit) / (1 - hatvalues(fit)))^2)
  })
)
kable(
  model.comparison,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Comparison of Candidate Regression Models",
  align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c"),
  booktabs = TRUE,
  col.names = c(
    "Candidate Model",
    "Adjusted R-squared",
    "AICp",
    "SBCp",
    "PRESSp"
  )
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center",
    font_size = 11
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "3.5cm", bold = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(2:5, width = "2.3cm")
```

#V
```{r}
final.model <- full.model

r <- resid(final.model)
yhat <- fitted(final.model)

plot(yhat, r, pch = 16, cex = 0.5, xlab = "Fitted Price", ylab = "Residuals", main = "Residuals vs Fitted")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "red")

qqnorm(r, pch = 16, cex = 0.5, main = "Normal Q-Q Plot of Residuals")
qqline(r, col = "red", lwd = 1)

std.res <- rstandard(final.model)
leverage <- hatvalues(final.model)
n <- nobs(final.model)
p <- length(coef(final.model))

train$ID[which(abs(std.res) > 3)]
train$ID[which(leverage > 2 * p / n)]
```
#VI
```{r}
s <- summary(final.model)

s$r.squared
s$adj.r.squared
s$fstatistic[1]
pf(s$fstatistic[1], df1 = s$fstatistic[2], df2 = s$fstatistic[3], lower.tail = FALSE)

alpha <- 0.05
g.beta <- 2

bonf.beta <- confint(final.model, level = 1 - alpha / g.beta)
bonf.beta[c("Square_Meters", "Num_Bathrooms", "Garage_Size"), , drop = FALSE]
```

## VII
```{r}
#Finding realistic predictor profiles
temp.train <- train
temp.train$pred <- predict(full.model)
temp.train <- temp.train[order(temp.train$pred), ]
id <- round(quantile(1:nrow(temp.train), probs = c(0.15, 0.5, 0.85)))
profiles <- temp.train[id, ]

#Creating intervals
g <- 3
mean.response.CI <- predict(full.model, newdata = profiles, interval = "confidence", level = 0.95)
new.obs.PI <- predict(full.model, newdata = profiles, interval = "prediction", level = 0.95)
sim.mean.response.CI <- predict(full.model, newdata = profiles, interval = "confidence", level = 1 - (0.05/g))
sim.PI <- predict(full.model, newdata = profiles, interval = "prediction", level = 1-0.05/g)
#Testing which value is smaller Scheffé or Bonferroni
df <- df.residual(full.model)
B <- qt(1 - 0.05 / (2 * g), df = df)
S <- sqrt(g * qf(1 - 0.05, df1 = g, df2 = df))

#Format multipler table
crit.val.table <- data.frame("Critical Value Type" = c("Scheffé", "Bonferroni"), "Multipler" = c(S, B), check.names = FALSE)
kable(crit.val.table, align = "c", caption = "Bonferroni vs. Scheffé Multiplers", escape = FALSE)

#Format interval table
profile <- profiles$ID
fit <- c(mean.response.CI[1,1], mean.response.CI[2,1], mean.response.CI[3,1])

list1 <- c(paste(round(mean.response.CI[1,2]/1000,1), round(mean.response.CI[1,3]/1000,1), sep = ", "), paste(round(mean.response.CI[2,2]/1000,1), round(mean.response.CI[2,3]/1000,1), sep = ", "), paste(round(mean.response.CI[3,2]/1000,1), round(mean.response.CI[3,3]/1000,1), sep = ", "))

list2 <- c(paste(round(new.obs.PI[1,2]/1000,1), round(new.obs.PI[1,3]/1000,1), sep = ", "), paste(round(new.obs.PI[2,2]/1000,1), round(new.obs.PI[2,3]/1000,1), sep = ", "), paste(round(new.obs.PI[3,2]/1000,1), round(new.obs.PI[3,3]/1000,1), sep = ", "))

list3 <-c(paste(round(sim.mean.response.CI[1,2]/1000,1), round(sim.mean.response.CI[1,3]/1000,1), sep = ", "), paste(round(sim.mean.response.CI[2,2]/1000,1), round(sim.mean.response.CI[2,3]/1000,1), sep = ", "), paste(round(sim.mean.response.CI[3,2]/1000,1), round(sim.mean.response.CI[3,3]/1000,1), sep = ", "))

list4 <-c(paste(round(sim.PI[1,2]/1000,1), round(sim.PI[1,3]/1000,1), sep = ", "), paste(round(sim.PI[2,2]/1000,1), round(sim.PI[2,3]/1000,1), sep = ", "), paste(round(sim.PI[3,2]/1000,1), round(sim.PI[3,3]/1000,1), sep = ", "))

total.interval.table <- data.frame(Profile = profile, Fit = fit/1000, "Mean Response CI" = list1, "Prediction Interval" = list2, "Simultaneous Mean Response CI" = list3, "Simultaneous Prediction Interval" = list4, check.names = FALSE)
kable(total.interval.table, align = "c", caption = "Housing Price Intervals ($ in thousands)")
```
